warning: service api: environment: a node has no environment of its own; the 2 variable(s) are baked into the image with kling image import -e (every copy of it sees them)
warning: service api: ports: 8081:8081: graph up does not publish it on the host (kling compose up does, on 127.0.0.1:8081)
warning: service db: ports: 5432: graph up does not publish it on the host (kling compose up does, on a free 127.0.0.1 port)
warning: service db: volumes: data:/var/lib/postgresql/data: a new volume has a lost+found that initdb refuses; PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata is set (baked into the image)
warning: service api: environment DB_HOST: host "db" rewritten to "db.graph" (a node is reached as <node>.graph)
